<details open>

ui: move Llama Chat to SvelteKit 3 and its built-in service worker (#32463)

* ui: replace deprecated packages and fix npm audit findings

Swap the mdast stub for @types/mdast, move the katex override to 0.19.0,
and override glob, source-map and html-encoding-sniffer under
workbox-build and http-server so installs no longer pull deprecated
packages. Apply the non-breaking npm audit fixes to the lockfile.

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium)

* ui: migrate Llama Chat to SvelteKit 3 and its built-in service worker

Move to SvelteKit 3, Vite 8, TypeScript 6 and Storybook 10.6. The
SvelteKit options move from svelte.config.js into sveltekit() in
vite.config.ts, $lib imports become #lib subpath imports from
package.json, and $app/environment becomes $app/env. Modules named
server.* or living under a server/ folder are server-only in SvelteKit 3,
so the llama-server components, store and enums move to llama-server
names.

@vite-pwa/sveltekit and Workbox give way to SvelteKit's own service
worker in src/service-worker, registered by usePwa(), which precaches the
app files and leaves API requests to the network. A small plugin emits
manifest.webmanifest. static/sw.js removes the worker of older builds, and
llama-server serves a self-removing service-worker.js as well as sw.js
when the built-in UI is off or replaced.

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium)

* ui: use SvelteKit 3's update detection and Svelte 5's current patterns

A page the service worker doesn't control now learns of a new build
from SvelteKit itself: `updated` from $app/state checks
_app/version.json on navigation, on focus and every hour. It replaces
the version Llama Chat kept in localStorage and compared by hand.

items.name: b12473
items.body:
<details open>

cuda : raise shared mem limit only for the launched kernel (#32392)

This commit removes a call of the CUDA_SET_SHARED_MEMORY_LIMIT macro as
the fallback decision was moved out of launch_mul_mat_q.
launch_mul_mat_q now has the fallback template parameter which was added
in Commit 6eddde06a4f25d55d538b5d15628dcc2b6882147 ("CUDA: refactor MMQ
kernel configuration (#24127)").

This code was then refactored in Commit
c49edf0963a76d5e78b2a7278c9bd5b71d26c84f ("CUDA: fuse FFN gate/up
matmuls and GLU in MMQ with interleaved gate/up rows (#29948)") which
added the has_fusion template parameter but it kept both macro calls.

launch_mul_mat_q only launches one type of kernel now (this is now
decided earlier in the templated call chain) and each specialization
will set the limit itself.

The motivation for this is to simplify the code and improve readabilty.

</details>
